subject: FinTechCorp - Security & Incident Response follow-up
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@fintechcorp.com>, Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: FinTechCorp - Security & Incident Response follow-up (post-demo)

Hi Emma / Rajiv —

Thanks for taking the time to meet earlier today — great conversation and appreciate you walking through the FinTechCorp requirements. Quick recap and proposed next steps on the security/compliance items we discussed: 

1) SOC 2
- We can share an executive summary of our SOC 2 Type II (Security) certification immediately. Our most recent attestation is for 2024; we also have an ongoing program with annual re-attestation.
- If you need the full report we typically share under NDA/PO.

2) GDPR / HIPAA
- Redwood supports GDPR controls for data subjects and processing; for regulated healthcare workloads (HIPAA) we offer Private deployment options and will sign a BAA for covered workloads. Please confirm whether FinTechCorp will route PHI through our hosted API or plan a Private deployment.

3) Vendor security questionnaire
- I’m attaching a short vendor questionnaire link to collect the standard fields and will also send a completed vendor questionnaire from our side. Please use: https://forms.redwood.com/vendor-security-questionnaire/FTC-1458

4) Incident response & breach notification
- Our standard practice: initial acknowledgement within 24 hours, preliminary incident assessment within 72 hours, and a formal notification consistent with legal requirements and contract terms. We’ll provide IR contact details and playbooks on request.

5) BCP / DR evidence we can provide
- Disaster recovery plan summary
- RTO / RPO targets and last DR test date
- Backup schedule and retention
- Recent DR test runbook and results (redacted as needed)

Proposed next steps / timeline: 
- I’ll upload our SOC 2 executive summary + BCP overview to a secure share (attached) by EOD.
- Please confirm procurement timeline and who on your side will own the vendor questionnaire.
- If acceptable, we’ll prepare an NDA so we can share the full SOC 2 report and any redacted evidence you need.

Attachments (stubs): SOC2-Redwood-2024-Executive-Summary.pdf, BCP-Overview.pdf

Thanks — happy to jump back on a call if it helps.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@fintechcorp.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@fintechcorp.com>, FinTechCorp Procurement <procurement@fintechcorp.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FinTechCorp - Security & Incident Response follow-up (post-demo)

Jordan —

Thanks for the recap and the quick turnaround. A few clarifying items from our end: 

- We will need the full SOC 2 Type II report for our security review team (will be shared under NDA). Is your 2024 report shared across hosted and dedicated offerings or segmented?
- Is Redwood able to enter into a BAA for HIPAA workloads if we keep data on the hosted product, or would you recommend Private deployment for PHI?
- For incident notification, we need contractual language for notification within 72 hours for confirmed breaches; can you share the exact wording you propose?

Procurement timeline: initial legal/security review complete by 2026-04-02, procurement decision by 2026-04-16. I’ll loop in our procurement lead once we have the SOC 2 doc and the completed questionnaire.

I’ll assign our security engineer to the questionnaire (expect a response by 2026-03-22).

Thanks,
Emma Johnson
Head of Security Programs
FinTechCorp
emma.johnson@fintechcorp.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@fintechcorp.com>, Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 17:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FinTechCorp - Security & Incident Response follow-up (post-demo)

Emma —

Appreciate the note. Short answers and what we’ll provide: 

- SOC 2 scope: The 2024 SOC 2 Type II (Security) attestation covers our hosted Redwood API and the core control environment (infrastructure, access controls, change management). For Dedicated/Private deployments we provide additional documentation; we’ll call that out in the attachment.
- BAA/HIPAA: For hosted deployments we require a short intake to assess the use of PHI. For customers with PHI we typically recommend Private deployment and will execute a BAA. We can share draft BAA language after we confirm the deployment option.
- Breach notification language: Sample contractual language is below (we can include in the contract): 
  "Redwood will notify Customer without unreasonable delay and, in any event, within 72 hours of confirming a security incident affecting Customer data and will provide a preliminary incident assessment within 72 hours and a substantive update within five (5) business days."

I’ve uploaded the SOC 2 executive summary and BCP overview to a secure drive link and attached short copies here for your initial review. Also sharing our vendor questionnaire link so you can assign an engineer: https://forms.redwood.com/vendor-security-questionnaire/FTC-1458

Attachments (stubs): SOC2-Redwood-2024-Executive-Summary.pdf, BCP-Overview.pdf

Laura / Marissa — quick FYI: Emma asked about what we can share immediately vs under NDA and confirmation on breach-notice wording. Can you confirm shareability and the IR contact?

Thanks,
Jordan
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 17:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: FinTechCorp - SOC2 sharing / breach notice language (internal)

Laura / Marissa —

Following up from the FinTechCorp thread — can you please: 
- Confirm whether the SOC2-Redwood-2024-Executive-Summary.pdf is safe to send to the customer as-is. If not, what redactions do you want?
- Confirm whether we can share the full SOC 2 after an NDA and whether we need legal to attach a PO.
- Confirm our incident response contact and any standard internal playbook items to include (oncall email, escalation path, SLAs).
- Quick check on BCP evidence availability: last DR test date and RTO/RPO targets we can share publicly.

I’ve attached the two stubs I sent to FinTechCorp for reference.

Jordan
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 17:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: FinTechCorp - SOC2 sharing / breach notice language (internal)

Jordan / Marissa —

Thanks — we can share the executive summary immediately. For the full SOC 2 report, we require a signed NDA (our standard template) and request procurement attach a PO if they want an unrestricted copy. Redaction guidance attached.

Incident response / contact: oncall-security@redwood.com (primary), security-leads@redwood.com (escalation). We commit to initial acknowledgement within 24 hours of detection and formal notification as described (72 hours for confirmed breaches).

BCP / DR evidence: shareable items include DR plan summary, RTO of 4 hours for critical services, RPO of 24 hours, and last full DR test: 2025-11-12 (results available under NDA for full runbook). We can provide sanitized runbook excerpts without NDA.

Attachments (stubs): Redaction-Guidelines.txt

Laura Bennett
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@fintechcorp.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@fintechcorp.com>, FinTechCorp Procurement <procurement@fintechcorp.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FinTechCorp - Security & Incident Response follow-up (post-demo)

Jordan —

Perfect, thank you. We have everything we need to kick off the review: the SOC2 exec summary and BCP overview look good for initial screening. I’ll assign our engineer to the questionnaire and share procurement contact by EOD. We expect to start the security/legal review the week of 2026-03-22.

Next steps on our side: procurement will reach out to get NDA in place so we can receive the full SOC 2 report if needed.

Thanks again — will be in touch.

Emma
